basic_profile.bio: A DIY enthusiast from Salem, Massachusetts, FixItFella84 has spent years honing his skills in home improvement projects. He enjoys tackling challenges around the house, whether it be fixing drywall pops or installing new fixtures. When he's not busy with projects, he loves playing 'Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order' and cheering on the Richmond Football Club. Typically online in the evenings, he balances his time between online communities and his job as a construction manager. Married for over a decade, he often shares insights from his professional experience with fellow Redditors.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With over 15 years in the construction industry, primarily focusing on residential renovations, FixItFella84 has gained extensive expertise in drywall installation and repair. His knowledge is a blend of formal training and hands-on experience, allowing him to offer practical advice to others.
